name: bedrock-now-code
description: The Code page's backend (./stack code). The Agent SDK moves in lock-step with the terminal's Claude Code pin (its claudeCodeVersion = terminal/claude-code's version; code/test/pins.test.mjs checks it). npm ci checks every tarball against package-lock.json

scripts.test: node --test $(for f in test/*.test.mjs; do grep -qxF "${f#test/}" test/one-at-a-time.txt || echo "$f"; done) && node --test --test-concurrency=1 $(sed 's|^|test/|' test/one-at-a-time.txt)
